description: Performance reports (read-only). Choose a view: view=table: Performance table for a campaign or ad squad broken down by ad squad or ad: spend, purchases, ROAS, CPA, swipe rate and frequency (read-only). Times must fall on the hour, with offset. view=daily: Day-by-day performance (spend, purchases, ROAS, CPA, swipe rate) for a campaign, ad squad or ad, up to 31 days (read-only). Day boundaries must be local midnight with offset. view=hourly: Which hours of the day work best? (read-only) Spend, purchases, ROAS and cost per purchase for each local hour of the day, summed over the last 1-7 full days, with the best and worst hours and four dayparts. Account level by default, or one campaign, ad squad or ad. Hours follow SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET. view=compare: Compare two time windows for a campaign, ad squad or ad, optionally per child (ad squads or ads): spend, purchases, ROAS, CPA, frequency, swipe rate and the changes (read-only). view=audience: Performance split by country, gender, age, region, dma or make (read-only), for a campaign, ad squad or ad.

breakdown.description: How to split the table: by ad squad or by ad.

current_end.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the whole day is included, so it means the start of the next day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

current_start.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the start of that day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-19T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

days.description: How many whole days back to look, counted from the start of today in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET.

dimension.description: What to split the audience report by, for example age, gender or country.

end_time.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the whole day is included, so it means the start of the next day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

previous_end.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the whole day is included, so it means the start of the next day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-20T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

previous_start.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD: the start of that day in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET) or an ISO date-time on the hour with an offset, such as 2026-10-19T00:00:00+03:00 (Snap needs whole hours).

swipe_up_attribution_window.description: Pin the swipe attribution window; default is the account's setting

view.description: Which report: table, daily, hourly, compare, audience.

view_attribution_window.description: Pin the view attribution window; default is the account's setting
